question: Does moment matching worsen LPIPS relative to the frozen full teacher as well as to GT?
inputs: Same two frozen E16 seed42 checkpoints and source states used by E17; 20 official test cameras and times.
metrics: For each view render full teacher, mean-covariance student and moment-matching student at800; LPIPS Alex0.1 normalize=True to teacher and to GT, teacher-relative L1 and MSE. Reproduce E17 GT LPIPS within0.0002.
outcome: If student-to-teacher LPIPS worsens too, teacher pixel training loss is misaligned with perceptual similarity. If it improves while GT LPIPS worsens, teacher bias contributes. Both cases remain observational.
limits: No training or model selection. Same scene repeatedly explored; no causal claim or new method validation.
